description_zh: 将明确指定的本机文件临时分享给同一局域网的手机或电脑。先检测本地配置，再生成本地二维码与下载页面，支持自动过期、提前停止和临时副本清理。适合交付需求文档、操作手册、图片与资料包。macOS已有客户端实测；Windows/Linux为实验性支持，原生CI已通过，实际网络与客户端仍需验收。HTTP未加密。
description_en: Share explicitly selected local files with devices on the same LAN. Check local capabilities first, then create an offline QR code and a temporary download page with automatic expiry and early stop. macOS has client-level testing; Windows/Linux support is experimental with native CI coverage. Real LAN and client acceptance remain pending. HTTP is unencrypted.
author: zcjunblog
examples_zh: 把刚生成的需求确认书分享给我的手机，先检测本地配置，十分钟后关闭。
将我指定的这三份操作手册生成局域网扫码下载页，五分钟后自动过期。
停止刚才的文件分享，确认下载入口已关闭、临时副本已清理。
examples_en: Share the requirements document just generated with my phone. Check local capabilities first and close the share after ten minutes.
Create a LAN QR download page for these three selected manuals and expire it after five minutes.
Stop the previous share and verify that the listener is closed and temporary copies are removed.
